scientific_integrity: All new claims supported by exact signed integer chain contractions and an explicit mod-two map calculation; any homotopy-stronger claim is unproved.
scientific_limitations: Twelve-vertex icosahedral graph, ordinary five- and six-cut complexes only; integral additive homology and their degree-four inclusion, not a homotopy wedge or an all-graph theorem. Indexed literature may omit equivalent work.
title: A free-to-torsion homology map in the icosahedral cut-complex filtration
